statements: If it rains tomorrow, then the game will be cancelled.
The game will not be cancelled.
Therefore, it will not rain tomorrow.
If the alarm sounds, the door will lock.
Either the CEO approved the budget or the CFO did.
The CEO did not approve the budget.
Therefore, the CFO approved the budget.
No valid employee has ever been fired.
Therefore, John has not been fired.
If Alice studies hard, she will pass the exam.
The system is either secure or it is not monitored.
Every person who attends the meeting must sign in.
